import sys
from collections import deque

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
p = list(map(int, input[1:n+1]))
s = list(map(int, input[n+1:]))

pos = {x: i for i, x in enumerate(p)}
min_coins = 0
k = 0
operations = []

for i in range(n):
    if p[i] != s[i]:
        target_pos = pos[s[i]]
        p[i], p[target_pos] = p[target_pos], p[i]
        min_coins += abs(i - target_pos)
        operations.append((i + 1, target_pos + 1))
        pos[p[target_pos]] = target_pos
        pos[p[i]] = i

print(min_coins)
print(len(operations))
for op in operations:
    print(op[0], op[1])
